properties.timeline: The M5 extension and renovation project is in equipment and finishing works in 2026, with service to Les Viviers planned for 2027.
properties.description: Charleroi is completing the light-metro extension from the existing network toward the Les Viviers terminus and the future Grand Hôpital de Charleroi in Gilly.
milestones: Two new stations at Corbeau and Les Viviers
Electrical and signaling works scheduled in 2026
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Charleroi central network–Gilly–Les Viviers corridor; the reused and extended infrastructure is schematic.

properties.name: Lausanne Metro M3
properties.agency: Canton of Vaud / Ville de Lausanne
properties.timeline: The planned third metro line will connect Lausanne station and the city centre with the northern Blécherette district; the station interface and route concept are being refined.
properties.description: Lausanne’s M3 is intended to add a north–south metro axis from the main station toward Blécherette, complementing the existing M2 and the planned tram network.
milestones: Third metro line retained in city planning
Northern Blécherette connection remains the core objective
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Lausanne station–Chauderon–Blécherette corridor; station configuration and final alignment remain under design.

properties.name: Grand Paris Express Line 15 East
properties.agency: Société des grands projets / Île-de-France Mobilités
properties.timeline: The eastern section of Grand Paris Express Line 15 is under construction, with first service planned for 2031.
properties.description: Line 15 East will complete the eastern arc of the Grand Paris Express between Saint-Denis Pleyel and Champigny Centre, serving Seine-Saint-Denis and eastern Val-de-Marne.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Saint-Denis Pleyel–Drancy–Bobigny–Champigny corridor; the station and tunnel alignment is schematic.

properties.name: Nantes Tram Line 6
properties.timeline: The new Line 6 is being built between Rezé and Babinière, with delivery planned for the end of 2027.
properties.description: Nantes Tram Line 6 will cross the Loire and connect Rezé, the Île de Nantes, central Nantes, and La Chapelle-sur-Erdre.
milestones: Rails installed on the Île de Nantes
Pont Anne-de-Bretagne works support the line
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Rezé–Île de Nantes–Nantes–Babinière corridor; new track and stop locations are schematic.

properties.name: Nantes Tram Line 7
properties.timeline: The new Line 7 is being built between Rezé and François Mitterrand in Saint-Herblain, with delivery planned for the end of 2027.
properties.description: Nantes Tram Line 7 will connect Rezé and the Île de Nantes to the western districts of Nantes and Saint-Herblain.
milestones: New rails laid on the Île de Nantes
Shared bridge and interchange works underway
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Rezé–Île de Nantes–François Mitterrand corridor; new track and stop locations are schematic.

properties.name: Nantes Busway Line 8
properties.timeline: The electric Busway Line 8 is being prepared between Bouguenais and Thouaré-sur-Loire, with service planned for September 2027.
properties.description: Nantes Busway Line 8 will provide a new cross-metropolitan electric rapid-transit connection using the new Loire crossings and upgraded corridors.
milestones: Electric Busway route planned at about 24 km
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Bouguenais–Nantes–Thouaré-sur-Loire corridor; dedicated lanes and stop locations are schematic.

properties.name: Lisbon Metro Circular Line
properties.timeline: The Circular Line extension between Rato and Cais do Sodré is in its final construction and systems phase.
properties.description: Lisbon Metro is joining the Rato and Cais do Sodré branches through new stations at Estrela and Santos to create the Circular Line.
milestones: Rato–Cais do Sodré tunnel and stations under construction
Cais do Sodré works tracked through monthly reports
Final systems and finishing works continuing in 2026

sources.title: Siga os trabalhos das obras de expansão da linha Circular
Obras da linha Circular continuam a avançar

properties.geometry_note: Approximate Rato–Estrela–Santos–Cais do Sodré alignment; tunnel and station geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Lyon Tram T9
properties.timeline: The new T9 is being built between Vaulx-en-Velin La Soie and Charpennes, with service targeted for 2026.
properties.description: Lyon Tram T9 will create a new east-side north–south connection through Vaulx-en-Velin and Villeurbanne, linking the La Soie and Charpennes areas.
milestones: New bridge works support the crossing near Croix-Luizet
properties.geometry_note: Approximate La Soie–Vaulx-en-Velin–Villeurbanne–Charpennes corridor; new track and bridge alignment is schematic.

properties.name: Lyon Tram T6 Extension to La Doua
properties.timeline: The northern extension of Lyon Tram T6 to La Doua entered service on 14 February 2026.
properties.description: The T6 extension adds a new east-Lyon connection from Hôpitaux Est through Villeurbanne and the Gratte-Ciel district to the La Doua university campus.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Hôpitaux Est–Grandclément–Gratte-Ciel–La Doua corridor; the opened extension is represented schematically.

properties.name: Budapest Buda Tram Network Phase II
properties.agency: Budapesti Közlekedési Központ / Ministry of Construction and Transport
properties.timeline: The second phase of the Buda interwoven tram network is funded, with preparatory works expected to begin in autumn 2026 and completion planned for 2029.
properties.description: The project will build a 2.8 km double-track tram connection from Szent Gellért tér along the Danube to the Kopaszi-gát and BudaPart area.
milestones: EU and state funding agreement signed
Seven pairs of accessible stops planned
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Szent Gellért tér–Műegyetem rakpart–Kopaszi-gát corridor; final track and stop geometry is schematic.

properties.name: Budapest Pest Tram Network Phase II
properties.timeline: The second phase of Budapest’s Pest interwoven tram project is in permitting design for a new tram route along Bajcsy-Zsilinszky út and southern Váci út.
properties.description: The project would restore a central Pest tram connection between Lehel tér and Deák Ferenc tér and improve links to the inner-city network.
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Lehel tér–Bajcsy-Zsilinszky út–Deák Ferenc tér corridor; route and stop design remain subject to permitting.

properties.name: Marseille Tramway Extension to Place du 4 Septembre
properties.timeline: The Catalans tramway extension from Rue de Rome toward Place du 4-Septembre was the subject of a public inquiry in May and June 2026.
properties.description: The planned extension would take Marseille’s tram network west through the Catalans and Pharo area toward Place du 4-Septembre.
milestones: Public inquiry opened by prefectural order
Inquiry held from May to June 2026
Final alignment and delivery remain subject to the project process
properties.geometry_note: Approximate Rue de Rome–Catalans–Place du 4-Septembre corridor; final alignment and stop locations remain subject to approval.
